releases.notes:
# 1.0.0 - Initial Release 🎉

## ✨ Features
- Craft the **"WuSan Exercise Book"** to start quizzes
- **8 fixed questions**: 1 Chinese + 4 Math + 3 English
- **Rewards**: Netherite Ingot for correct answers
- **Punishment**: Lightning strike for wrong answers
- **Rare drop**: 1% chance to get the powerful "WuSan Sword"
- **Configurable**: `/gamerule summonLightningOnWrong false` to disable lightning

## 🔧 Requirements
- **Minecraft**: 1.21.8-1.21.10
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric
- **Dependencies**: Fabric API

## 📥 Download
- [**Direct download**](https://github.com/qiufengcute/StudyMod/releases/download/1.0.0/studymod-1.0.0-fabric-1.21.8.jar)
- [**Modrinth page**](https://modrinth.com/mod/studymod)

If you find any issues, please report them on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/qiufengcute/StudyMod/issues).
